# FDG5090

> DO NOT provide an implicit conversion operator if the conversion is potentially lossy.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.7.2 Conversion Operators.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not checked: whether a conversion between custom types loses information depends on their ranges, which symbols do not show.

## From the book

For example, there should not be an implicit conversion from `Double` to `Int32` because `Double` has a wider range than `Int32`. An explicit conversion operator can be provided even if the conversion is potentially lossy.
